boundaries: No binary, OpenSpore source, SPORE file, or historical triage artifact is modified.
The artifact describes static state and lifecycle contracts only; it does not claim original runtime observations.
SDK names, enum values, and field offsets establish shape only unless corroborated by a body or disassembly.
No integer-to-state inference is used for raw flags, transition fields, lighting state, or unnamed owner fields.
Persistent planet records, visual cPlanet objects, terrain assets, and world-object records are kept as separate domains until a producer/consumer link is proven.

evidence_policy.decompilation: Committed Ghidra exports and live Ghidra decompilation are behavior evidence; decompiler casts, missing names, and damaged signatures are not authoritative.
evidence_policy.disassembly: Read-only Ghidra control-flow and call relationships are used where an imported body is missing or address alignment is inconsistent.
evidence_policy.kg: The read-only KG sidecar and committed KG projections are used for structure association, xref inventory, and provenance; no KG write is performed.
evidence_policy.runtime: No original world/planet runtime trace exists in the current corpus; runtime validation remains a future read-only experiment.
evidence_policy.sdk_name_only: SDK structures and method names are capped at interface-shape evidence unless a matching body or disassembly is present.

Marked address mismatches between SDK exports and current Ghidra function entries instead of treating them as proof of identity.
